cases.explain: «Лживый свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

cases.explain: «Лживый свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

cases.explain: «Царский гнев» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

cases.explain: «Глупый сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

cases.explain: «глубокий сон» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

cases.explain: «Негодный свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
